'''Celwis''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] in the [[Celwis system/Legends|Celwis system]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It was located on the [[Vagaari Corridor]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that ran through the Unknown Regions. Celwis was once regularly attacked by [[Alien/Legends|alien]] aggressors, but it eventually became a demonstration of [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] military strength shortly after the formation of the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Celwis was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square F-8.<ref name="TEA" />
